description: MUTATES one existing Food Diary row the authenticated user owns. Required: food_id (UUID). Optional patch (same fields as log_food): what, kind, contains_alcohol, dish_items, place, merchant, notes, append_notes (concat), consumed_at (ISO instant) / meal_period (profile TZ), amount, currency, paid_by (self / a name / unknown), payment_method (how it was paid, saved on the linked Finance transaction), expense_id (link one existing owned Finance transaction; null unlinks), with / people_names / person_ids. dish_items replaces the complete ordered dish list. A dish or notes correction never creates another Finance transaction. Unknown or other-user food_id or expense_id returns an error and changes nothing. Returns changed fields and a fresh linked_expense read. Syncs the mirrored calendar event and rebuilds life_state. Requires API key or OAuth with scope context. Share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

calories.description: Correct the kcal value (0 is a real value). Stored as user-stated unless calories_source says agent_estimate. To clear it to unknown (not zero; totals skip it) send null, or calories_source "unknown" without calories. Omitted = unchanged, except that a corrected `what` re-derives an automatic estimate (never a user-stated value)

calories_source.description: Provenance of calories: user (the user said it, default) or agent_estimate (your estimate). unknown (without calories) clears the kcal value

contains_alcohol.description: Correct whether the item contains alcohol (true for beer, wine, spirits, cocktails, an "alcoholic beverage")

description.description: Alias for what (the dish, not notes).

dish_items.description: Complete replacement ordered dish list; [] clears it.

expense_id.description: Link this entry to ONE existing Finance transaction you own (UUID), so the meal has one ledger row. Empty or null unlinks; the transaction stays in Finance

food_id.description: UUID of a food diary row the authenticated user owns

meal_period.description: Spoken period when consumed_at is omitted, e.g. "late lunch"

merchant.description: Restaurant, stall, or shop. Empty or null clears

notes.description: Replaces notes. Empty or null clears

paid_by.description: Who paid. A person's name or alias for a third party; "self" / "me" = the user paid (recorded in Finance); "unknown" = payer not known. Empty or null clears. Not a payment method

payment_method.description: How it was paid (cash, card, PayLah…). Saved on the linked Finance transaction; never changes paid_by

person_name.description: One companion to add, by name

place.description: Venue or location. Empty or null clears

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

what.description: Full updated dish/drink text (replaces, does not append). Example: Salmon Bento + hot tea

with.description: Companion names, aliases, or ids to add (does not remove existing tags)
